description: Rotate a workspace API token. The current token is required; the replacement is shown once and the old token stops working immediately. Example: invoke workspace_token_rotate with the required arguments shown in its input schema; use the workspace or resource credentials issued by Zorqelio, never placeholder credentials in production.

operationId.description: Stable unique request identifier. Reuse it only for an exact retry.

workspaceToken.description: Secret API token for the workspace; keep it private.

name: workspace_token_rotate
